closure.title: Tell us how the explanation worked
closure.standfirst: Eight short questions about the explanation you were given, and one optional question about future services. They are about the explanation, not about you.
closure.syntheticNote: Answers here are for made-up (synthetic) people only. Do not enter real health or family details.

empty.title: The questions are not available yet
empty.body: The questions load from the service, and none came back. Your pathway page is the place to start again.

partial.service: The future-services question could not be loaded, so it is left out for now. The questions below are complete.

success.title: Thank you

error.body: Nothing was lost on this page. You can try again.

quiz.title: Practise what you have learned
quiz.standfirst: Short questions to check that the explanation was clear. They are practice for understanding, not a test of you.

empty.title: No practice questions yet
empty.body: Practice questions appear once your result is available. Your pathway page shows where you are.

quiz.draftStamp: Draft translation: clinical lead sign-off pending

intro.heading: Check that the explanation made sense
intro.body: There are no marks to earn and nobody is judging your answers. If a question is unclear, that tells us the explanation can be better. You can leave any question blank and try again as often as you like.

quiz.submitNote: Answered {answered} of {total}. You can leave any question blank.

result.note: This is practice for understanding. There is no cut-off, and each answer comes with a short explanation.

error.title: Your answers could not be checked
error.body: Nothing was lost on this page. You can try again.
